title: How to Install PostgreSQL and pgAdmin
summary: Step-by-step install of the Postgres server together with pgAdmin on Windows or macOS using the EnterpriseDB installer.

concepts.heading: Installation steps
points: Download the installer for your OS (separate Windows and Mac links are given in the lesson) and double-click it.
Allow the installer to run: choose Yes on the Windows permission prompt; on a Mac choose Open and enter your Mac password if asked.
Click Next through the wizard until the component list, and make sure everything is ticked, pgAdmin in particular (it is the GUI used in the following lessons).
At the password screen the superuser name is postgres. Pick a password and write it down: it goes into the db connection config in Node later.
Leave all other options at their defaults, click Next until done, then Finish.
If Stack Builder opens after install, close it; the course does not use it.

concepts.heading: Defaults worth remembering
points: (Extra) The default port is 5432 and the host is localhost; both go into the pg client config along with user postgres and your password.
(Extra) The notes here are based on the lesson's text as mirrored in the reference repo, because the article body opens in a separate window and could not be read inline.

pitfalls: Forgetting the superuser password set during install; it cannot be skipped and is needed for pgAdmin and Node.
Leaving pgAdmin unticked in the component list, so no GUI is installed.
